instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. Under an outdoor covered shelter, the boxer in the beige t-shirt and black sweatpants (R1) stands on the left, facing right with his back partially to the camera. He extends his left arm to punch a black focus mitt. On the right, the trainer in the green long-sleeve shirt and red shorts (R3) stands facing him, holding up the mitts to catch the blow. No bystanders are present in the background. Bright natural daylight illuminates the concrete floor and pillars, casting soft shadows.
elements: R1 is the boxer throwing a punch toward the focus mitt
R3 is the trainer holding up the focus mitts to catch R1's blow
R1 punches the mitt held by R3 rather than holding mitts for R3
R3 catches or absorbs R1's punch with the mitts rather than throwing the punch
A black focus mitt is used as the contact object
The action takes place under an outdoor covered shelter
